User story: As a visitor, I can understand Liftosaurus and begin sign-in.
Expected behavior: The landing page exposes the marketing headline and a Sign in menu with GitHub.
Verification evidence: Playwright tests/home.spec.ts: 3/3 passed after current-label contract update.

User story: As an eligible user, I can sign in with GitHub or the enabled agent test account.
Expected behavior: Provider selection starts authentication and returns to the current route after sign-in.
Verification evidence: Implemented in LoginProviderMenu.svelte; no dedicated successful-provider browser run.

User story: As a signed-in user, I can view today's workout and start a planned or unplanned workout.
Expected behavior: Dashboard displays workout state and offers the appropriate start action.
Verification evidence: Dashboard auth and metrics unit coverage passed (130/130 unit suite).

User story: As a user, I can inspect bodyweight and performance metrics.
Expected behavior: Metrics use my data only, calculate configured trends, and render chart states safely.
Verification evidence: Dashboard unit coverage passed; first browser suite included dashboard coverage with no failure artifact.

User story: As a user, I can start a workout with bodyweight and the appropriate mesocycle day.
Expected behavior: Start flow validates bodyweight, handles rest/skipped days, and preserves an active draft safely.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73, including mobile start and mesocycle workout starts.

User story: As a user, I can log weights, reps, and RIR for each set.
Expected behavior: Set completion persists values, supports all set types, and keeps a shared exercise-level RIR control.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; all-set-types logging and exercise-level RIR fixtures passed.

User story: As a user, I can add, remove, edit, reorder, and compare exercises during a workout.
Expected behavior: Exercise actions update the active draft without losing completed-set data.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73, including exercise editing, deletion, comparison, and deload flows.

User story: As a user, I can finish a workout only after all required sets are complete.
Expected behavior: The exercise area scrolls independently; a single Finish workout action appears when all sets are complete.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73 with the single Finish workout transition.

User story: As a user, I can review and save a completed workout.
Expected behavior: Overview validates bodyweight and persists a new or edited workout atomically.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; create and edit overview saves passed.

User story: As a user, I can browse, filter, inspect, edit, and delete completed workouts.
Expected behavior: History is scoped to my account and edits never overwrite another user's workout.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73, including workout model and edit-security cases.

User story: As a user, I can resume a draft across reloads and tabs without exposing it to another account.
Expected behavior: Active and edit drafts are isolated, versioned, and fail closed when storage locks are unavailable.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; all 10 cross-tab draft cases passed.

User story: As a user, I can create an exercise split from scratch.
Expected behavior: Structure validation requires unique workout names and each day has exercises before save.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; exercise split creation passed.

User story: As a user, I can create a split from a provided template.
Expected behavior: Template creates editable days and exercises, then returns to the split library.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; template and clone cases passed.

User story: As a user, I can clone, edit, delete, export, and import exercise splits.
Expected behavior: Operations preserve ordering, validate imported data, and scope data to my account.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; split model and export coverage passed.

User story: As a user, I can create a mesocycle from an exercise split.
Expected behavior: Wizard requires basic settings, a split, valid volume inputs for active muscle groups, and then saves the mesocycle.
Verification evidence: Focused Playwright creation test passed with session-capable database connection and adaptive volume fixture.

User story: As a user, I can edit, start, stop, delete, and complete a mesocycle.
Expected behavior: Lifecycle actions preserve ownership, update active state, and retain historical data.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; all 8 mesocycle model cases passed.

User story: As a user, I can edit or extract a mesocycle's exercise split before workouts lock structural changes.
Expected behavior: Exercise edits persist; structural changes are disallowed after workouts are added; extraction creates a standalone split.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; split edit, lock, and extraction cases passed.

User story: As a user, I can choose reps-first or load-first progression and configure RIR, adaptive ranges, and set changes.
Expected behavior: Preferences are inherited correctly and progression stays within valid rep/load bounds.
Verification evidence: Progression, adaptive-range, and preference unit tests passed.

User story: As a user, I can deload an exercise or muscle group without corrupting normal progression.
Expected behavior: Deload targets are halved correctly, exclusions remain monotonic after completed sets, and comparison excludes deloads.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; all 8 manual-deload cases and related unit cases passed.

User story: As a user, I can browse exercise performance cards and complete progression chart history.
Expected behavior: Cards paginate independently from chart history and chart filters preserve data integrity.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73; all 12 exercise-statistics cases passed.

User story: As a user, I can correct a historical exercise muscle group.
Expected behavior: Exact-name history is updated only for my account; built-in and custom values are validated.
Verification evidence: Exercise muscle-group unit coverage passed and no first-pass failure artifact targets this path.

User story: As a user, I can download owner-only JSON and CSV backups.
Expected behavior: Exports are authenticated, include completed data, use safe CSV escaping, and neutralize formula injection.
Verification evidence: Data export unit tests passed; endpoint browser coverage has no first-pass failure artifact.

User story: As a user, I can view profile activity and run supported data migration.
Expected behavior: Profile is authenticated, displays activity, and migration reports success or errors.
Verification evidence: Route implementation inspected; no dedicated browser story.

User story: As a user, I can manage notifications, quotes, and data export preferences.
Expected behavior: Settings updates persist, notification permission/errors are visible, and downloads are available.
Verification evidence: Route implementation inspected; no dedicated browser story.

User story: As a returning user, I can recover from a failed update and continue with drafts intact.
Expected behavior: PWA update flow detects broken stylesheets, activates a waiting worker, and preserves draft storage.
Verification evidence: PWA recovery/update unit tests passed.

User story: As a mobile user, I can use a fixed navigation bar and scroll only the workout exercise area.
Expected behavior: Navigation remains visible, outer workout frame is fixed, and safe-area spacing avoids clipped actions.
Verification evidence: Full Playwright suite passed 73/73, including dashboard and workout-start mobile geometry.

User story: As a user, I cannot read, modify, export, or delete another user's workouts or data.
Expected behavior: All server operations are account-scoped and reject anonymous or cross-user requests.
Verification evidence: Workout edit security, dashboard auth, and export unit/browser coverage passed in available baseline.
